decisions.reason: As the flagship cloud email service closely aligned with the firm's messaging expertise and strategic direction, its absorptive capacity is very high, so the likelihood of withdrawal is minimal.
The document capture service builds on established document workflow and file exchange knowledge, enabling effective learning and improvement, though it is less central than the flagship.
Email and fax conversion leverages existing multi-channel messaging capabilities, allowing the firm to assimilate feedback, but the fax element faces a gradually declining market.
As a fax delivery optimization feature close to the core fax offer, the firm can readily understand its performance, but its narrow scope makes it somewhat more likely to be absorbed or retired.
Multi-engine email virus scanning is closely related to the firm's email security services, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine the product from threat intelligence and usage data.
